title: Saturn's South Pole Has a Giant Decagon
mediaSource: Saturn south pole decagon Hubble 2026 NASA atmosphere

scenes.title: Saturn has a new geometric mystery
scenes.narration: Saturn is famous for the hexagon around its north pole. Now astronomers have found a giant ten-sided atmospheric wave around the south pole.
keywords: Saturn south pole decagon Hubble NASA

scenes.title: Hubble watched it emerge over years
scenes.narration: By combining Hubble observations, researchers found subtle hints of the structure starting in 2023 before it developed into a much clearer decagon.

scenes.title: It stretches through several atmospheric layers
scenes.narration: The ten-sided wave is not just one cloud band. Observations suggest the pattern extends through multiple layers of Saturn's southern atmosphere.

scenes.title: It resembles the northern hexagon but is different
scenes.narration: Saturn's northern hexagon is also linked to atmospheric waves and jet streams, but the southern decagon appears to have a different shape and evolution.

scenes.title: Scientists still do not know why it has ten sides
scenes.narration: Fast and slow-moving gas can create large waves, but exactly why this pattern formed ten sides will require more observations.

scenes.title: Saturn is still changing before our eyes
scenes.narration: Even after decades of observation, Saturn keeps producing new atmospheric patterns. Scientists now want to know how long this decagon will survive.
